summary: Qualify canonical release checkout preflight and exact-head delivery

delivery.outcome: Qualify direct-main release preflight and exact-head delivery for canonical Worktrees v5 release checkouts (.worktrees/ticket-NNN--slug) with explicit --ticket, active change lease, exact authoritative remote base SHA, and independent terminal merge receipt, revalidating after tests and pushing only the release tag without touching primary checkouts or moving main.
nonGoals: Do not allow source commits or branch movement on main during canonical release publication.
Do not modify dependency manifests or lockfiles.

architecture.decision: Add CanonicalReleaseAdmission and validate_canonical_release_checkout in goal/governance/delivery.py to verify Worktrees v5 layout, relative gitlink, symlink-free path components, non-duplicate worktree registration, clean working tree, exact remote base SHA, active wellmanifest.change-lease/v1 lease, and independent terminal merge receipt; integrate preflight, post-test revalidation, and tag-only remote push into execute_push_workflow in goal/push/core.py.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of the ticket-218 commit.
